intentComment: Story 060 — yield-strategy swap migration (June 12 2026): replace buggy ERC4626YieldStrategy DOLA/USDC instances on StableStaker via two-leg bounce through a temp staker
scriptHeaderIntent: Story 060 - Step 1 of the yield-strategy swap migration. Deploys ysDolaV2, ysUsdcV2, tempStaker, migrator1 (original->temp), migrator2 (temp->original); wires phUSD.setMinter(tempStaker,true), tempStaker.addToken(DOLA/USDC), setMigrator(migrator1) on both stakers, and setClient/setSetAsideBufferRecipient/setSetAsideBuffer(10) on both V2 strategies pointing at the ORIGINAL staker; writes deployment addresses JSON.

preview.previewMechanism: vm.envOr(PREVIEW_MODE) -> vm.startPrank(OWNER_ADDRESS); writes ys-swap-deployments-preview.json instead of the real file

jsChain.note: No node pre/post in either variant. The suite's off-chain input producer is the sibling key migrate:ys-swap-gather-leg1/-leg2 (scripts/gather-migration-inputs.js); gather-leg2 consumes THIS script's output JSON (.tempStaker). The mainnet-addresses backup/patch pair runs on the sibling key migrate:ys-swap-reset, not here.

preflightGuards: non-zero checks on OWNER, ORIGINAL_STABLE_STAKER, PHUSD, AUTODOLA_VAULT, AUTOUSDC_VAULT
